dos.title: Drink water from Pulpulaks
dos.description: Yerevan's streets are dotted with public memorial water fountains (Pulpulaks); the mountain spring water is crisp, cold, and free.

dos.title: Respect ancient monastery grounds
dos.description: When visiting holy sites like Geghard (UNESCO) or Khor Virap, dress respectfully with covered shoulders.

dos.title: Use GG or Yandex Go for taxis
dos.description: App-based taxis avoid overcharging by unmetered street cabs outside Republic Square and the airport.

donts.title: Don't photograph military border installations
donts.description: Strictly refrain from taking photos or flying drones near southern border checkpoints or military areas.

donts.title: Don't decline hospitality impolitely
donts.description: Armenian hospitality is deeply generous; accepting coffee or lavash with appreciation is customary.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants in Yerevan; some upscale venues include a 10% service charge automatically.
